note: Open sources of how things on the Earth look, for the Artist Website, and the hosts each needs (NETWORK.md; the artist, 10 Oct 2026). state: candidate (found), asked (in the block given to the artist), allowed (every host answers), used (a script reads it: used_by), dropped (why). Each host's state is the probe's (scripts/probe_sources.py): open, refused, stalls, silent.

sources.name: Openverse
sources.what: WordPress's search over 800 million openly licensed images (Flickr, Wikimedia, museums), with each image's licence and author.
sources.improves: Photographs of gallery rooms, buildings, plants and animals where Commons has none: more museums' walls read for their real paint, more buildings modelled from photographs.
sources.licence: Each image's own CC licence or public domain; the API's data CC0.
sources.notes: Refused by the network policy since at least 9 Oct 2026.

hosts.said: request blocked: no rule or allowlist entry allows host "api.openverse.org"

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons files
sources.what: upload.wikimedia.org: Commons' files and their thumbnails.
sources.improves: Reading a photograph's pixels directly (a gallery's paint measured in Lab, a building's materials) instead of through a vision model.
sources.notes: Allowed, but answers 429 to the session's shared address most of the time: not a network setting.

sources.name: Flickr (openly licensed photographs)
sources.what: Photographs and their licences; the image files themselves on Flickr's CDN.
sources.improves: The pictures Openverse and Commons point to: reading a gallery's or a building's colours off the photograph itself.
sources.licence: Each photograph's own licence; only CC and public-domain ones used.
sources.notes: Flickr's API needs a key; the photo pages and files do not.

hosts.said: request blocked: no rule or allowlist entry allows host "live.staticflickr.com"
request blocked: no rule or allowlist entry allows host "www.flickr.com"

sources.name: The Met's open-access images
sources.what: The Metropolitan Museum's image server: every public-domain work's photograph, full size.
sources.improves: The colours measured off a Met work's own photograph, and the works hung in the Met's walk drawn from the museum's own picture.
sources.notes: collectionapi.metmuseum.org (the data) is a different host.

hosts.said: request blocked: no rule or allowlist entry allows host "images.metmuseum.org"

sources.name: Wikimedia API gateway
sources.what: api.wikimedia.org: Commons' and the wikis' REST endpoints, rate-limited per address.
sources.improves: Commons' files' metadata and thumbnails without the action API's 429s from the session's shared address.
sources.notes: commons.wikimedia.org's pages and query.wikidata.org answer the session; the action API and upload thumbnails answer 429.

hosts.said: request blocked: no rule or allowlist entry allows host "api.wikimedia.org"
